en.headline: Primary schools to introduce AI-focused technology subject from 2028
en.dek: The Education Bureau announced a provisional curriculum framework for Information and Innovation Technology, covering AI and programming, to start in Primary 1 and 4 from the 2028/29 school year.
body: The Education Bureau has announced a provisional curriculum framework for a new Information and Innovation Technology subject in primary schools, with artificial intelligence as one of its highlights.

The framework, released on Friday, aims to enhance students' curiosity and interest in innovation technology, as well as their digital literacy and creativity. Students as young as seven will learn to hold simple conversations with an AI system using prompts or commands after studying the technology.

Schools will begin implementing the subject from Primary 1 and Primary 4 in the 2028/29 school year, with the option for prepared schools to roll it out more widely earlier. The curriculum will not form part of the internal assessment for secondary school places allocation, and schools are encouraged to use diversified assessment methods rather than paper-and-pencil tests alone.

The five learning strands include information technology concepts and applications, computational thinking and programming, a preliminary study of artificial intelligence, basic engineering and robotics-related technologies, and technology and society. The bureau has already released a pilot version of the AI strand for schools to trial.

zh.headline: 小學2028/29學年起推行資訊與創新科技科 涵蓋人工智能
zh.dek: 教育局公布課程框架擬定稿，小一及小四由2028/29學年開始推行，學生可學習簡單與人工智能系統對話。
body: 教育局公布小學「資訊與創新科技科」課程框架擬定稿，人工智能為其中重點內容之一。
框架於周五公布，旨在提升學生對創新科技的好奇心及興趣，以及數字素養與創意。年幼至七歲的學生在學習相關科技後，將能夠使用簡單提示或指令與人工智能系統進行對話。
學校將於2028/29學年由小一及小四開始推行，準備充足的學校可更早全校推行。課程不會納入呈分試，當局鼓勵學校採用多元化評估方式，而非僅依賴紙筆測驗。
五個學習範疇包括資訊科技概念與應用、計算思維與編程、人工智能初探、基礎工程與機械人相關技術，以及科技與社會。教育局已發放人工智能初探範疇的試行版，供學校試教。
